attribution: no swap while stood down on the desktop client: host behaviour by design (desktop_ui off)
the Mac's auto_update flip: expected sync outcome (the Deck's first-round stamp was newer), not a host defect
propagation delay until a Steam restart: Steam UI (roaming storage), not host
